implementation_plan: Create a versioned synthetic document set and a fixed query set with human-labeled relevant document IDs.
Generate embeddings using one selected model for both documents and queries, following the provider’s encoding guidance.
Implement a keyword baseline and an embedding similarity ranker; filter by user/tenant access before returning candidates.
Measure recall@k, precision@k, latency, and failure cases for both methods.
Document embedding model version/dimensions; any embedding model change should trigger an evaluated reindexing plan.

reference_test_cases.input: Query wording differs from relevant document wording
reference_test_cases.expected: Semantic ranking retrieves the relevant passage if embedding model supports the domain.
Keyword or hybrid search does not lose the exact match.

reference_test_cases.input: Relevant document belongs to another tenant
reference_test_cases.expected: Document is filtered out before it can appear in results.

answer.review_gate: Do not publish until a reviewer inspects the actual submitted implementation/results and confirms the acceptance criteria; outline completion alone is not completion.

explanation: Reference solution outline for Create a semantic search engine. It specifies a defensible implementation path, representative tests, and evaluation evidence. It is not a universally executable implementation: provider APIs, deployment environments, permissions, and available hardware vary. Use synthetic/test data, mock external services first, and keep credentials server-side. The exercise's current contains_all grader only checks required keywords and is a preliminary scaffold check, not a correctness/security evaluator; human review is required.
